# ElseIf

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ElseIf condition
Else If condition
```

## Description

Another condition for the block form of [If](If), tested only when the conditions before it were false. `Else If` written as two words means the same.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 15
If n < 10
	Print "small"
ElseIf n < 20
	Print "medium"
Else If n < 30
	Print "large"
EndIf
```

```text
medium
```
